analysis.context_freedom: Each node has independently meaningful instructions and context. Reuse only naturally identical prefixes; do not homogenize nodes or omit relevant evidence to increase hits.
diagnostics: Role handoff failures,normalizer use,revisions and extra contacts
Batch dispatch wall/count and throughput, explicitly separate from individual latency
efficiency_anchor: Actual admission-to-settled-workflow elapsed mean over all20 samples
First admitted sample elapsed time reported separately
Actual elapsed mean over the remaining19 samples; no other exclusions
analysis.read: All exact family members finalized,sealed,one unique successful complete official score each,zero failed jobs,then exact root READ. No partial quality or optimizer export.
required_business_constraints: Official pooled SLU-F1 and intent with paired uncertainty and own A/A
Reliable Omni delivery,finite/abstained/failed cases,per-stratum support and natural/equal weighting
Review complete quality/latency evidence before choosing a feasible configuration; cache hit rate is not a promotion gate
analysis.selection: Root reviews complete paired quality,reliability,all-sample and remaining-sample latency before choosing a feasible tradeoff. No stable-benefit or global-optimum claim from20; do not silently downgrade business performance to cache efficiency.

timing_boundaries.concurrency_limit: First4 admissions are only a diagnostic group; not necessarily simultaneous GPU work or a cold wave. No assumption that samples2-20 are fully warm.
timing_boundaries.first_rule: Admission index0 from the frozen roster, regardless of completion order
timing_boundaries.sample: Admission to workflow settlement including internal waits, FIT, tools and cleanup
timing_boundaries.separate: Pre-admission waiting; batch wall/count; whole flight wall; official scoring
timing_boundaries.source: saea-sample-execution-timing-v1 original monotonic boundaries, identical instrumentation in all new members

business_reporting.reliability: Retain every input,including finite deliveries,abstentions,normalizer use and control failures; report separately from correctness.
business_reporting.strata: Report per-scenario support, official counts and intent with natural-mixture and equal-scenario summaries; pooled official number remains primary. Empty-support strata remain absent,not zero.
business_reporting.tradeoffs: Show all four configurations and both repeats; do not choose a cache metric or one favorable replicate after seeing results.

optional_timing: Require export_system_sample_timing complete original coverage for all newly flown members. Also use export_system_node_timing. Historical missing boundaries remain unavailable.
order_limit: Symmetric position balances linear time trend only. Cache history and numerical batching effects remain; no flush,warmup,save/restore or service changes. Report first versus later contacts and both repeats.
raw_request_audit: Every original contact/body/FIT/control hash; before-speech additionally shared original ORG layout audit; actual requested slot identities for role-affinity
read_gate: All eight independently FINALIZED,verified seals,one unique successful complete official score each,zero failed jobs,then exact root READ. No partial quality or optimizer export.
scores: Exactly one official complete score per member; no failures or replay
source_rule: No earlier update3 role annotations or old scored rows enter this new family.
status: REGISTERED BEFORE CONTACT; scientific READ UNSIGNED

uncertainty.claim: Descriptive optimization/form proof only;no stable benefit,formal no-harm,global optimum or learning claim from20.
uncertainty.latency: Report each repeat separately and paired mean deltas on all20 and remaining19;first admission fixed by actual executor roster. No trimming,metric substitution or cold/warm assumption.
uncertainty.null: Own A/A differences for every configuration; sampling intervals do not eliminate order/cache-history effects.
uncertainty.quality: Official aggregate SLU-F1; paired official per-input TP/FP/FN where the qualified scoring view supplies them, recomputed aggregate ratios per bootstrap;never mean per-input F1. Intent accuracy paired on the same roster.
uncertainty.unit: Paired input identity;do not treat the two repetitions as independent inputs
